brief_description: GHDL-emitted VCD (VHDL simulator), shipped in Yosys's test suite (`tests/sim/var_reference_with_whitespace.vcd`) as a regression for whitespace handling in `$var` directives. Distinct from iverilog/Verilator output: includes `$date` directive, multiple top-level VHDL package scopes (`standard`, `std_logic_1164`), and timescale at `1 fs`. Exercises the GHDL simulator-origin axis of the parser.
anchors: scope `tb` exists alongside VHDL standard library scopes `standard` and `std_logic_1164`
timescale is `1 fs` (femtoseconds) — unusual for Verilog flows
